messages:
zoe: quick thing from today's UX pass — the midnight palette looks slick but the series colors on the throughput chart are losing contrast when overlaid on the panel gradient. when there are 4+ lines it becomes hard to track. can we try a slightly brighter set for the primary series and desaturate less important ones? :memo:

dave: agreed. i'm thinking keep the primary series at `#52e3c2` but bump to 72% instead of 60% (visually ~#2bd9aa). secondary series can go to 38% saturation and a slightly higher lightness. also gridlines: prefer 0.06 opacity instead of 0.12, they read too heavy now.

kristin: accessibility check: small legend text with colored swatches must remain >4.5:1. also charts with thin dotted lines can disappear for users with low vision. suggest we add a bold focus state and alternate stroke (dash + 1.5px) for active series.

zoe: nice — that focus state idea helps interactive charts a lot. can we also standardize code-block bg between console and query editor? right now console is `#0c0d0e` and editor is `#0b0c0d`, tiny diff but adds visual noise when switching tabs.

design-bot: uploaded frames: /design/midnight-lines-v2 and updated token file `tokens/midnight.json`. frame v2 uses primary `#2bd9aa` @ 72%, secondary decreased sat, gridline `#121417` @ 6%. also added active stroke 1.6px.

contrast-bot: running token checks on frame v2...
- primary series vs panel bg: 6.9:1 ✅
- secondary series (desat) vs panel bg: 4.2:1 ⚠ (below 4.5 for small elements)
- gridline (`#121417` @ 6%) vs panel bg: 3.1:1 ✅
- legend swatch + small label: 4.4:1 ⚠ (just under 4.5)

dave: bummer on the legend. options: slightly darken secondary series or embolden legend text by 100 weight. which do we prefer? emboldening might affect layout.

kristin: prefer darkening secondary series by a hair so we don't change typography. an increase of ~6% lightness should hit 4.6:1. i'll add that tweak to the token PR.

zoe: copy nit for the metrics header: current "Show per-route latency" -> "Per-route latency (median / tail)" reads clearer to product folks. also add tooltip that explains p50/p95.

design-bot: noted. pushing copy suggestion to `console/headers` branch.

dave: final micro: monospace weight for inline code in body — 450 felt better in the last run. can we set monospace body token to 450 and code-block title to 600?

kristin: that should be fine contrast-wise. please include a quick screenshot test in the PR showing long query wrap.

zoe: thanks everyone. plan: kristin will tweak tokens, dave will update figma lines and push screenshots, design-bot will land token PR once checks pass. will test on staging with heavy charts tomorrow AM. :rocket:

(attachments: figma link, screenshot_before_after.png, token diff link)
